Strategy: Reward residuals between thirty and forty-five while penalizing residuals between eight and twenty-two only lightly, testing whether a gentle push away from awkward gaps suffices. This keeps most Best Fit behavior intact, but the weak penalty may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (10 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
